note: Gate: scripts/qcm/control-register.test.mjs. Every field is data; a fact the code does not settle is written "unverified". Derived rows (layers, context, base) must match layer-registry.js and source-basemaps.js id for id.

controls.purpose: Link back to the Headless Mode home page.
controls.effect: Loads the site home page.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter.
controls.untested: No test file under scripts/qcm names this control; the gate and the unit that owns it should add one.

controls.purpose: Link to the Methodology & data section lower on the same page.
controls.scope: Page scroll position and the URL hash only.
controls.effect: Scrolls to the documentation section; the hash becomes #documentation (not a #map= view, so the map is left alone).
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter.

controls.purpose: Retry loading the county data after the dashboard reports a load failure.
controls.scope: County data load; shown only after a failure.
controls.effect: Hides the error banner and runs the data load again.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.
controls.untested: No test file under scripts/qcm names this control; the gate and the unit that owns it should add one.

controls.purpose: The map itself, a focus stop for keyboard pan and zoom.
controls.effect: Arrow keys pan, plus and minus zoom; the new view is written to the #map= link a moment later.
controls.keyboard: Tab to the map, then arrow keys pan and +/- zoom.

controls.purpose: Zoom in and Zoom out buttons on the map.
controls.effect: Zooms the map one level in or out.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.purpose: Home button that returns the map to the whole country.
controls.effect: Flies the map to the contiguous-US bounds.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.purpose: Use my location: one position request, never a background watch.
controls.scope: Map view; a location marker and the Conditions panel; the browser location permission.
controls.effect: Asks the browser once for a fix; on success flies to it and drops a marker, otherwise says why in #qc-locate-status.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.purpose: Include my approximate location in a shared link.
controls.scope: What Share view writes into the link; never sent anywhere.
controls.effect: Shown only while the map center came from my location. Unchecked, Share view leaves the center out of the link; checked, it is included.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Space toggles it.

controls.purpose: Opens the 3D terrain view of the area on screen.
controls.scope: 3D terrain dialog for the current map bounds.
controls.effect: Opens a modal dialog (aria-modal) with its own controls: North up / reset view, Tilt up, Tilt down, Exaggeration, Close.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.purpose: Phone-width fold chip that shows or hides the map credits.
controls.effect: Toggles aria-expanded and the credits box.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.purpose: Phone-width fold chip that shows or hides the map key.
controls.scope: Map key box on the map.
controls.effect: Toggles aria-expanded and the key box.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.purpose: Credit links in the map attribution (Leaflet, us-atlas and the tile sources).
controls.effect: Opens the credited project in a new tab.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter.

controls.purpose: Share view: copies a link to what is on screen.
controls.effect: Writes the #map= link (center, zoom, base, surface, overlays, county metric and opacity, labels) and says in #qc-view-status that it was copied.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.purpose: Reset view: back to the default display.
controls.scope: Map view, base, labels and the display-prefs key; never the print recipe, a saved print project or a drawn area.
controls.effect: Clears qc-field-maps-display-prefs and the URL fragment, then redraws the default view.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.purpose: Search places by name: opens the finder pane on the map.
controls.effect: Shows or hides the pane and moves focus to the search box.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.purpose: The finder box: a town, a coordinate pair or a place name.
controls.effect: Typing lists matching towns or coordinates; Escape clears the query, then closes the pane.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, type; Up/Down arrows move through the suggestions, Enter picks one, Escape clears.

controls.purpose: Search names: asks the Geographic Names service for peaks, gaps and the like.
controls.effect: Lists matching named features; the status line says when the answer is partial or empty.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.purpose: One suggestion row in the finder list.
controls.scope: Map view and the selected place.
controls.effect: Flies to the place and opens its card.
controls.keyboard: Reach with the arrow keys from the search box (rows are not in the tab order), then Enter.
controls.untested: No test file under scripts/qcm names this control; the gate and the unit that owns it should add one.

controls.purpose: Phone bottom-sheet handle that resizes the panel.

controls.purpose: Phone Expand button for the panel sheet.

controls.purpose: Map title printed on the sheets.
controls.effect: Sets the title text.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then type.

controls.family: Print scale / paper / DPI / extras / build / download
controls.scope: Sheet plan, page count and estimate.
controls.effect: Re-plans the sheets.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then arrow keys (or Alt+Down) choose an option.

controls.family: Print scale / paper / DPI / extras / build / download
controls.purpose: Sheet overlap (0.25, 0.5 or 0.75 in).
controls.effect: Re-plans the sheets.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then arrow keys (or Alt+Down) choose an option.

controls.family: Print scale / paper / DPI / extras / build / download
controls.purpose: Paper orientation, portrait or landscape (Letter).
controls.effect: Re-plans the sheets.
controls.keyboard: Tab into the group, then Up/Down (or Left/Right) arrow keys move the choice.
controls.untested: No test file under scripts/qcm names this control; the gate and the unit that owns it should add one.

controls.family: Print scale / paper / DPI / extras / build / download
controls.purpose: Grid on the sheets: UTM 1 km or none.
controls.scope: Printed sheets. The recipe holds the grid but the restore on load does not apply it.
controls.effect: Draws or omits the UTM grid.
controls.keyboard: Tab into the group, then Up/Down (or Left/Right) arrow keys move the choice.
controls.untested: No test file under scripts/qcm names this control; the gate and the unit that owns it should add one.

controls.family: Print scale / paper / DPI / extras / build / download
controls.purpose: Quality: 300 or 200 dpi.
controls.scope: Printed sheets and the download estimate.
controls.effect: Changes render resolution.
controls.keyboard: Tab into the group, then Up/Down (or Left/Right) arrow keys move the choice.

controls.family: Print scale / paper / DPI / extras / build / download
controls.purpose: Check sources: confirm each chosen layer has data for the area.
controls.scope: Source-state lines and the Build gate; network requests.
controls.effect: Checks each chosen layer's service for the area; Build stays disabled until the check allows it.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.family: Print scale / paper / DPI / extras / build / download
controls.purpose: Build the PDF on this device.
controls.effect: Renders the sheets; progress and Cancel appear, then Download.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.family: Print scale / paper / DPI / extras / build / download
controls.purpose: Cancel a build in progress.
controls.effect: Aborts the build; shown only while building.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.family: Print scale / paper / DPI / extras / build / download
controls.purpose: Download the built PDF.
controls.effect: Saves the PDF; shown only after a build.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter.

controls.family: Print scale / paper / DPI / extras / build / download
controls.purpose: Print the key: a one or two page symbol sheet for the chosen layers.
controls.effect: Builds the key PDF and offers Download.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.family: Print scale / paper / DPI / extras / build / download
controls.purpose: Download the map key PDF.
controls.effect: Saves the key PDF; shown only after it is built.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter.

controls.family: Print scale / paper / DPI / extras / build / download
controls.purpose: Calibration sheet: one page to measure printer scale error.
controls.effect: Builds the calibration PDF and offers Download.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space.

controls.family: Print scale / paper / DPI / extras / build / download
controls.purpose: Download the calibration sheet.
controls.effect: Saves the calibration PDF; shown only after it is built.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter.

controls.purpose: The two scrollable table regions on the Field Maps docs page (state land coverage; sources and terms).
controls.effect: Scrolls a wide table sideways without moving the page.
controls.keyboard: Tab to the region, then arrow keys scroll it.

controls.purpose: The Release details disclosure in the system sheet (published month, version, demo source).
controls.effect: Shows or hides the release details.
controls.keyboard: Tab to it, then Enter or Space opens or closes the section.
controls.untested: No test file under scripts/qcm names this control; it comes from the shared system-sheet partial (themes/headlessmode/layouts/partials/system-sheet.html), added on master after this register.

layerCheckboxes.purpose: A layer switch: one checkbox per non-base, non-surface row of layer-registry.js, context overlays included.
layerCheckboxes.keyboard: Tab to it, then Space toggles it.

roads.effect: Shows or hides "Road names" on the map; the print recipe reads the same switch.

epaEcoregions.effect: Switches on the written reading "What kind of country this is (EPA ecoregions)" for the drawn area; it puts a sentence in the panel, not ink on the map.
